content: this is a summary of a legal text regarding a court appeal in antwerp the procedure lasted for approximately 1 year and a few months the text discusses a case involving a married couple and the division of their joint assets the spouse who performed unpaid work for the family is claiming recognition and compensation for their contributions various documents were filed and a notary public was appointed to handle the liquidation and distribution of assets the husband has raised objections to the proposed distribution and the court has deemed them admissible the case is ongoing and the notary public will be responsible for executing necessary actions the husband is seeking compensation for assets that benefited the family but they must be proven to be part of the common property the husbands compensation claims for the family home are rejected as the court considers his efforts a gift rather than a legally obligatory contribution the text also emphasizes the importance of considering the employment efforts of both spouses in the division of matrimonial property and the establishment of compensation accounts
